_comment: 011. Each level-up offers three of these (seeded, never one already taken, only ones that do something for this machine: `needs`) and the player keeps one. `grid` is an additive bonus block (see data/parts/makers.json). needs: melee | ranged | shot (086: a straight shot, what pierce works on) | ability | chain | shovable (not already unshovable) | stops (cannot already move after attacking).
_086: 086 (A8): `rule` perks change what the machine does (tears, mark, pierce, kill_heal, thorns -- keys CombatSetup.apply_bonus reads); they replace Heat Sinks and Coolant Jacket, and every level offer holds at least one (RunSim.perk_offer).

plating.name: Extra Plating
plating.text: +1 armour: every hit on it deals 1 less.

hot_loads.name: Hot Loads
hot_loads.text: +1 damage on every weapon; each attack makes 1 more heat.

rending_grip.name: Rending Grip
rending_grip.text: Every hit it lands tears off an arm.

spotter.name: Spotter
spotter.text: Its hits mark the target: the next hit on it deals more.

ap_rounds.name: AP Rounds
ap_rounds.text: Its shots pierce into the machine behind; its other weapons deal +1.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.text: Each kill patches it for 2 HP.

barbed_hull.name: Barbed Hull
barbed_hull.text: A machine that hits it in melee takes 1 damage.

quick_cycle.name: Quick Cycle
quick_cycle.text: Its abilities are ready a round sooner.

arc_relay.name: Arc Relay
arc_relay.text: Chain weapons arc to one more target.
